visualLocks.face: Warm light skin, brown eyes, dark eyeliner, same fine facial identity as the V2 portrait; tiny iris geometry unresolved.
visualLocks.hair: Dark brown hair swept into a high coiled bun, mechanical gold clock ornament and dark-blue ribbons trailing behind; loose curls at temples. No goggles, no long free ponytail.
visualLocks.costume: Navy-blue Renaissance military long coat with gold piping and fine gold clock embroidery, broad raised collar, gold shoulder armor (layered anatomicalRIGHT, round gear on anatomicalLEFT), white pleated neck cravat and small blue/gold brooch, brass watch/chains/belt and brown leather pouch. Cream trousers, tall navy boots with gold edge and clock ornaments, dark gloves and gold-trim forearm guards. No teal skirt or exposed shoulders.
visualLocks.equipment: One narrow straight silver rapier in anatomicalRIGHT hand, ornate gold open circular basket guard with visible spring-coil assembly and small blue accents. AnatomicalLEFT hand free. Source blade exits left crop; whole length/tip are conservative extrapolation, not established exactly.
visualLocks.anatomy: Natural human proportions, one head, two arms/two legs and natural hands. Keep source apparent age; no invented adult status.
visualLocks.universe: Méridiana Renaissance clockpunk city, astronomical clocks, brass springs/weights/automata and deep-blue gilded towers. Seraphine protects citizens free minutes against Grand Horloger and Chronophage. Fresh settings coherent with this original internal world, not source screenshots.
visualLocks.silhouette: Human fencing captain, compact high mechanical bun, high navy/gold collar, long split coat tails, cream trouser legs and separate tall navy boots; no goggles or teal exposed-shoulder dress.
